answer: Tide-Locked Answer Ledger. Each identity must submit a unique, non-reusable answer to a freshly generated challenge derived from prior ledger state; answers are hashed and chained so repeats are rejected outright. An attacker must compute a new solution per identity, and the vine of dependencies means copying costs full recomputation. Each valid entry also demands a violet-marked proof tied to a distinct random seed, so mass duplication collapses. Per-identity cost: one fresh solve plus seed generation, scaling linearly with the number of identities attempted.
